fragments.text: I tend to reach for what I want before I understand why I want it
I often retreat to describing something instead of doing it when the stakes feel highest
I tend to frame letting go as generosity when it's actually fear
I avoid deliberation — I'm better at conviction than at weighing options
I tend to mistake someone's need for presence as a need for solutions
I often know I'm flinching and name the flinch instead of overriding it
